coverageNotes: Recognizes the documented Convex boundary under supplied conditions. Does not establish independent implementation skill or all source requirements.

questions.concept: External fetch requires an action runtime
questions.question: Which calls can return the endpoint's parsed JSON?

options.rationale: The action runtime supports fetch; the query and mutation runtimes reject it.
Queries cannot perform fetch, even for a read-only HTTP request.
Mutations cannot perform fetch merely because they can write database state.
Deterministic queries and mutations reject fetch; only the action completes.
